notes.title: Coming Soon It's Free!
notes.notes:
I made the decision to make the game completely free for all and forever!

Many thanks to everyone who tried the game - your support is very important to me and the money earned on the game I invested in the creation of a new project!

I hope such changes will help more people get acquainted with the game Two Against the Legion and get, albeit short, but an unforgettable gaming experience.

notes.title: Play it alone!
notes.notes:
Originally, Two Against the Legion is exclusively a cooperative game, but we decided to let those who want to play alone play as well.

Almost all puzzles could always be solved alone, just by paying attention to different characters, but when it comes to fighting with robots and hacking the computer, you can't switch your attention.

We decided to add a little trick and added a cheat to the game, which you can turn on at the beginning of the game or by applying the [b]ALT+1[/b] key combination at any point of the game.

You can place as many turrets as you want and use them to kill robots. In the meantime, you can solve the puzzle of computer hacking in peace.

notes.title: Second Live Stream "Two Against the Legion"
notes.notes:
Second Live Stream "Two Against the Legion"

Q n A session.
Talking with a developer!

We are pleased to present Two Against the Legion Demo at the Steam Next Fest!

Two against the Legion is a local couch co-op adventure puzzle game for two players, in which you have to defeat rebellious robots and prevent a technological disaster. The players have completely different game experiences.

Player 1 controls his character using a keyboard or a gamepad and sees the game in a third-person view.
Player 2 controls his character with a mouse and sees the game from a top-down perspective.

notes.title: Two Against the Legion – New Playtest
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings friends![/b]

[b]Glad to announce another playtest of Two Against the Legion![/b]

Your opinion is very important!

To participate in the playtest, you need to click "request access" on the game page and in a short time access will be granted automatically and the game will appear in your library.

If you have already participated in previous playtests, you need to do a game update.

To play online, use Steam Remote Play Together:
https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay

You can leave your feedback here, write an email or join the Discord server of UFO CAT GAMES studio:

email: ufocatgames@gmail.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/xhWSuCJN

New Gameplay VIdeo

[previewyoutube=6aILNMB02f8;full][/previewyoutube]


Thanks to everyone who took part in the past and wrote their feedback. I listened and made a lot of changes to the game, and it's really better and more interesting.

[b]A list of changes, or what's in store for you in the new version of the game:[/b]

01. It was decided to remove the online mode for now. But you can always play with a friend online, using Steam Remote Play.
02. There are new characters in the game. Girl Anny and her robot Jackie!
03. The visual style of the game became brighter and richer in colors.
04. Complicated some puzzles and added some new ones.
05. Improved animations.
06. Improved controls (Player 1 is now fully controlled from the gamepad).
07. Fixed a few minor bugs.
